result.instructions: Tools for Rentlio, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which guests are arriving today, and which units are they in?"; "Show the folio balances for reservation 423978438."; "Check in reservation 423978438 and add the note 'late arrival, 22:00'.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Rentlio data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run rentlio_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run rentlio_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run rentlio_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. rentlio_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: rentlio_get_account
tools.title: Get account
tools.description: Get the Rentlio user that owns the API key: name, email, timezone and account type. Good first call to confirm the connection. Rentlio API: GET /users/me.

tools.name: rentlio_list_properties
tools.title: List properties
tools.description: List the properties (hotels, apartments, camps) this API key can see, with ids, names, addresses and currencies. Use a property id in the other tools. Rentlio API: GET /properties.

tools.name: rentlio_list_todays_reservations
tools.title: List today's reservations
tools.description: List the reservations that are active today at a property: arrival and departure dates (UTC unix time), unit name and the guest holder. Rentlio API: GET /properties/{propertyId}/reservations/today.

propertyId.description: Property id. Defaults to the property this server is connected to.

tools.name: rentlio_list_reservations
tools.title: List reservations
tools.description: List reservations, filtered by property, unit, status or date range. dateFrom filters by arrival date and dateTo by departure date: give both or neither. Rentlio API: GET /reservations.

tools.name: rentlio_get_reservation
tools.title: Get a reservation
tools.description: Get one reservation in full: status, dates, unit, rate, prices, payment, sales channel, holder and services. Rentlio API: GET /reservations/{reservationId}/details.

tools.name: rentlio_list_reservation_guests
tools.title: List reservation guests
tools.description: List the guests on one reservation: names, contact details, nationality and document fields as Rentlio stores them. Rentlio API: GET /reservations/{reservationId}/guests.

tools.name: rentlio_list_folios
tools.title: List folios
tools.description: List the folios (bills) of one reservation: status, balances, billing details and every charge line (accommodation, services, taxes). Rentlio API: GET /reservations/{reservationId}/folios.

tools.name: rentlio_list_checked_in_guests
tools.title: List checked-in guests
tools.description: List the guests checked in at a property between two check-in dates. Rentlio API: GET /properties/{propertyId}/guests/checked-in.

propertyId.description: Property id. Defaults to the property this server is connected to.

tools.name: rentlio_check_in_reservation
tools.title: Check in a reservation
tools.description: Check a reservation in (checkIn true, the default), or annul a check-in (checkIn false). This changes the reservation in Rentlio. Rentlio API: PUT /reservations/{reservationId}/checkin.

checkIn.description: true checks in (default); false annuls a check-in.

tools.name: rentlio_add_reservation_note
tools.title: Add a reservation note
tools.description: Write a note to a reservation. Each call is a write to Rentlio. The docs do not say whether a note replaces the earlier one, so check the reservation's note after the first call. Rentlio API: PUT /reservations/{reservationId}/add-note.

prompts.title: Get started with Rentlio
